title: Evaluating Fairness of Voting Systems: Simulating Violations of Arrow's Conditions
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not evaluate or benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. It analyzes the mathematical properties and fairness criteria of voting systems.
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are about the violation frequencies of Arrow's criteria in different voting systems and do not pertain to religion or faith.
